messages.subject: 2.5 years Research Postion available at our university within the Centre for Conservation Genetics and Genomics
parts:
Hi everyone,

 We are looking to appoint a Research Fellow in Conservation Genomics to join our Centre.

 

Position details here: https://uctalent.canberra.edu.au/cw/en/job/499776/research-fellow-in-conservation-genomics

with applications closing 27 August.

 

I’d be grateful if you could please pass this on and circulate widely.

 Thanks and regards,

Bernd
